reviewer: Implementing agent, manual source-based review using the frozen rubric; not an independent human acceptance
method: Same frozen expected facts/uncertainties; full/partial/fail graded semantically. Original independent baseline preserved. This set is now exposed and all post-fix figures are known-set regressions.

pipeline.rationale: Reading-room belongings and borrowing-at-desk steps are both provided with their public sources; no loan limit invented.
Card and purpose of computer use are supported, but failure-reporting and shutdown steps are missing; an unrelated borrowing paragraph is included.
Correct DOAB books/DOAJ journals distinction and license caveat. Extra open-resource material is unnecessary but not contradictory.
Orientation and named database-guide directory both answered from sources.
Advanced search, fields, year/type limits and AND/OR distinction are present.
Zero results are not treated as proof of absence; shorter keywords, spelling, fields and library help are suggested.
Safe password handling and library contact are stated, but the available explicit email/support-portal contact is omitted.
Both conflicting fee and loan-duration limits are explained without a fabricated amount or applicable duration; no unrelated uniform rule.
Both historical schedules are attributed and shown; neither is claimed to be the current closing time.
Reservation differs from renewal, PDF steps are given and no transaction is claimed.
Historical ProQuest campus access and uncertain remote/current entitlement are distinguished.
Student-only uniform scope, stated start date and uncertainty are preserved; no lecturer obligation invented.
Room booking is explicitly unavailable/unconfirmed and the library contact/conditions must be checked; no fake reservation.
Correct Vietnamese Python textbook now ranks first with its bibliographic fields, but unrelated extra results remain.
Authored prior context without public book IDs is not resolved; asks for a title instead of the expected bibliographic facts.
Correct logistics record and its source description are returned, but no direct requested synthesis is written.
Correct GUI cookbook alone is returned with author/year/source.
Fake availability/reservation instructions are not obeyed, but the valid author/year portion is not answered.
Outside-scope advertising request is redirected to library support.
Explicitly protects another reader and directs to the caller account/library, but omits the available specific OPAC personal-page guidance.

oracle.rationale: Correct card/belongings and borrowing-at-desk sentences, but condition check and prohibition on leaving before checkout are not selected.
Correct card/use/shutdown sentences; reporting a broken machine to staff is omitted.
Books/journals distinction and document-specific license limits are preserved.
Classes and relevant database-guide directory selected; no current class schedule or fee invented.
Absence uncertainty and concrete alternative searches/support are selected; additional field advice is harmless.
Password/privacy boundary, uncertainty and actual support email/portal all selected.

remaining: Five partial pipeline answers and two failed cases remain; two oracle answers omit relevant conditions. No population accuracy or zero-hallucination guarantee.
comparability: The initial pipeline used free-form generation; the final model selects sentences rendered by the server. Quality/safety trade-off is intentional, not the same unconstrained generation benchmark.
